posts.hook: Trump calls AI safety fears a hoax the same day experts say the AI kill switch won't work
posts.caption: trump says he'll name an ai czar and form an "ai force," dismissing safety fears as a hoax, while experts warn ai kill switch laws are far harder to build than lawmakers assume. unsealed court filings show a microsoft exec calling ai scraping "the largest theft of labor in human history." full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Trump plans an "AI Force," calls safety fears a hoax
slides.desc: He'll name an AI czar and police bad behavior through existing courts, not new rules.

slides.title: The AI kill switch may not work
slides.desc: Experts say a rogue or already-copied AI system could dismantle the shutoff itself.

slides.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping "theft of labor"
slides.desc: Unsealed filings show the 2023 quote, plus Nadella saying he'd have blocked paywalled training data.

slides.title: Meta's Muse seemed to know a chat it wasn't given
slides.desc: A user says he never enabled Messages access; Meta blames a bad self-explanation.

slides.title: Terence Tao on AI and mathematics, twice this week
slides.desc: One essay on why humans still matter, one on skipping the Fields medallists' AI warning letter.

posts.hook: The AI labs that promised to slow down for safety now face a lawsuit over it
posts.caption: a lawsuit says openai, anthropic, google and musk's ai arm secretly agreed to slow ai development together, a google mole was found inside a massive supply-chain hacking gang, and an open medical ai model beat most radiologists reading ct scans. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Musk's AI arm sued over a slowdown pact
slides.desc: A federal suit says their Sept 12 pact to slow AI together, not alone, breaks antitrust law.

slides.title: A Google mole was inside history's biggest supply-chain hacking spree
slides.desc: An undercover analyst tracked the group from within, warning victims and tipping off police.

slides.title: An open AI model reads CT scans and beat most radiologists
slides.desc: Alibaba's RADAR spotted about 150 abdominal conditions across nearly 40,000 real exams, study finds.

slides.title: Doctors warn medical AI is racing ahead of the evidence
slides.desc: Beyond reading scans, clinicians say real-world data on AI's broader care impact stays thin.

slides.title: Open AI models just flipped the market on Vercel's gateway
slides.desc: Closed models ran about 70% of tokens in June; by September their share fell to 21%.
